description: This file defines the Amqp10Config interface providing configuration settings for the AMQP 1.0 protocol, including various timeout and quantity parameters, as well as nested enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: Amqp10Config.Amqp10ConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values for Amqp10Config.

methods.name: isConsumerRateLimitEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether rate limiting based on throughput and acknowledgements is enabled.

methods.name: getConsumerMaxInFlight
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of unacknowledged messages allowed, including redelivered messages.

methods.name: getConsumerRedeliveryExpectationTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration for which redelivery requests are kept.

methods.name: getConsumerThrottlingInterval
methods.description: Returns the duration interval for consumer throttling, defaulting to the value from the throttling config.

methods.name: getConsumerThrottlingLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit of messages processed per throttling interval, defaulting to the value from the throttling config.

methods.name: getProducerCacheSize
methods.description: Returns the number of message producers to cache.

methods.name: getBackOffConfig
methods.description: Returns the backOff configuration used internally.

methods.name: getMaxQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of messages buffered before dropping.

methods.name: getPublisherParallelism
methods.description: Returns the number of parallel message publications allowed per publisher.

methods.name: getGlobalConnectTimeout
methods.description: Returns the connect timeout duration for the AMQP 1.0 client.

methods.name: getGlobalSendTimeout
methods.description: Returns the send timeout duration for the AMQP 1.0 client.

methods.name: getGlobalRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the request timeout duration for the AMQP 1.0 client.

methods.name: getGlobalPrefetchPolicyAllCount
methods.description: Returns the input buffer size for AMQP consumers.
